notes.title: The Kurukshetra War update coming up.
notes.content:
.With this update you will find all sorts of improvements and new content!
•    New playable characters
•    A new set of core quests
•    The conclusion to the epic story of the Pandavas
•    New enemies to face
Check out the update coming up!

notes.title: This Month !
notes.content: Later in December a free expansion will be added to Tales of Mahabharata. This expansion brings in an ancient war that leads to the deaths of millions. The war further expands upon the game and ends the story of the Pandavas. Pick up the game now for $4.99 so that you can join in on the ancient war expansion later in December.

notes.title: Stay tuned for:
notes.content: This holiday season treat someone with the return to Tale of the Mahabharata. Give the gift of an ancient story being told through the medium of a role playing game. Explore this ancient war and the family feud that leads to modern India.

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
Hello All,

We have pushed an update to the game. We have fixed the world map game crashing bug. Extended the tutorial and are working on the game play update next.

We shall post more updates soon. 

Stay tuned !

notes.title: Meet Bhishma "The Lord of Honor"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33201536/9f684e1b72e9fdd41a7988b81576d2605e4cd53f.png[/img]
My name is Bhishma, eighth son of King Shantanu and the Goddess Ganga. I spent the early part of my life training under six different sages, each taught me something different. I spent my entire life perfecting my skills till I became an unmatched archer and warrior. 
I could have made an excellent King, but my love for my family was greater than my greed for power.
